label: def:gs-quotient-ideals-I8-I9
title: Quotient ideals $I_8$ (adjacency correlation) and $I_9$ (closed-shell chain collapse)
html:
The raw Gröbner--Shirshov normal form (shell closure normal form) contains up to A! terms. Two quotient ideals reduce this complexity by absorbing structurally-determined reduced words into the per-generator transfer-matrix factorisation:

  • I_{8} (adjacency correlation): A reduced word \sigma_i \sigma_{i+1} of length 2 is absorbed into \sigma_{i+1} when the latter is present in the normal form. The coefficient of \sigma_i \sigma_{i+1} is structurally determined by the off-diagonal entry of the transfer matrix product M_i, rather than being independent.
  • I_{9} (closed shell chain collapse): A reduced word w \cdot \sigma_j is absorbed when its prefix w is present in the normal form. This implements the per-generator transfer matrix factorization by replacing the expanded Hecke element with the product of \hat{V}_i volumes.
